name: Adrian Keller
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
episode: The last light at the harbor
life: “I still remember photographing the owner locking a very small gate.” People around Maré Coffee know Adrian by a small Monday habit. Adrian likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: I have been photographing glamorous boats. The owner asked me to photograph the little walk from deck to door instead.
appearance: Adrian has a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape, one cheek that creases before the other, and a favorite piece of clothing, a dark green knitted vest. It usually goes with a pair of reading glasses in a cloth sleeve. When somebody else has the floor, Adrian listens with the head tilted a little to the left.
personality: Adrian has a talent for getting adversaries to laugh at exactly the same thing. Adrian knows better than to expect the laugh to settle what they are arguing about.
agenda: To photograph the unglamorous trip home.
family: Mateo Katz is Adrian’s second cousin. Adrian chooses whether they walk home or sit a while. Mateo brings a spare shopping bag. That small arrangement gives both a reason to see each other on weeks when asking for company outright feels difficult. Asked about *The empty chair on nights*, Mateo says, “I want one quiet breakfast with her outside work.”
connections: Joel Sun. A photographer learns which ordinary walk once belonged to the resident watching a former boat from shore.

reactions.situation: A cabin light stays on after its usual time
reactions.response: Adrian checks in through an ordinary contact before treating the late light as an emergency.

reactions.situation: A traveler asks for the last seat at the bus stop
reactions.response: Adrian gives up their own space if possible and asks the passengers who arrived first to choose what happens next.

reactions.situation: When people declare an argument over too soon
reactions.response: Adrian asks them to describe one concrete thing that will be different tomorrow.
